records.title: LongBench Pro: A More Realistic and Comprehensive Bilingual Long-Context Evaluation Benchmark
records.reason: LongBench Pro introduces bilingual long-context evaluation with more realistic/extreme-length tasks. It does not propose KV compression, but can evaluate retention and retrieval quality of KV selection/compression methods.

records.title: RFIDs and secret handshakes: defending against ghost-and-leech attacks and unauthorized reads with context-aware communications
records.reason: RFID security protocol paper, unrelated to LLM inference systems.

records.title: Microbenchmarking NVIDIA’s Blackwell Architecture: An in-depth Architectural Analysis
records.reason: The paper supplies microbenchmarks and architectural analysis for NVIDIA Blackwell, including tensor-core/memory features and ML workloads. This is hardware characterization, not an LLM serving technique; relevance is as measurement context.
